All 3 tests pass now.

**Fix:** `gridtools/io.py:13` — the loop bound was `len(edges) - 2` instead of `len(edges) - 1`, so it always emitted one fewer cell than the n-1 cells that n edges define (not just an odd/even parity bug — it dropped the last cell unconditionally). Changed to `range(0, len(edges) - 1)`.

**Evidence:** `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` — reproduced 2 failures before the fix, 3/3 pass after. No other files touched; contract (n edges → n-1 consecutive edge pairs) was already correctly stated in the docstring and tests, so this is a local D4 fix, not a spec change.
